title: Paragraph frame and unit quiz
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y8 lesson 22 (Paragraph frame and unit quiz (portal worksheet and Forms quiz))
intro: Covers lessons 13 to 22 of My family. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: How is فِي البَيْتِ read in joined speech?
questions.a: B) fi l-bayt. The alif of al- is not pronounced after a word: fi l-bayt.

questions.q: 'The first lesson' (حِصَّة, feminine) is:
questions.a: B) الحِصَّةُ الأُولَى. Feminine noun, feminine ordinal, after the noun: الحِصَّةُ الأُولَى.

questions.q: 'Where do you live?' to a girl is:
questions.a: B) أَيْنَ تَسْكُنِينَ؟. For 'you' feminine the present verb ends in ـِينَ: تَسْكُنِينَ.

questions.q: 'Maryam is Egyptian' is:
questions.a: B) مَرْيَمُ مِصْرِيَّةٌ. Maryam is female, so the nationality takes ـِيَّة.

questions.q: Which means 'my grandmother'?
questions.a: B) جَدَّتِي. جَدَّة + ـِي: ة becomes ت: جَدَّتِي.

questions.q: 'Her house' is:
questions.a: B) بَيْتُهَا. ـهَا means her; ـهُ means his.

questions.q: A far-away car (سَيَّارَة):
questions.a: C) تِلْكَ سَيَّارَةٌ. Far and feminine: تِلْكَ.

questions.q: Which means 'This house is big'?
questions.a: B) هٰذَا البَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ. هٰذَا البَيْتُ (this house) + كَبِيرٌ (is big). Option 1 means 'This is a big house'.

questions.q: 'My sister is younger than me':
questions.a: B) أُخْتِي أَصْغَرُ مِنِّي. Comparative أَصْغَرُ + مِنْ; it does not take ة.

questions.q: Which link word means 'but'?
questions.a: B) لٰكِنَّ. لٰكِنَّ = but; أَيْضًا = also; وَ = and.

questions.q: Bismillah. Which mark means no vowel? A) sukun B) shaddah C) fathah
questions.a: A) sukun

questions.q: What does إِمْلَاء mean? A) dictation B) reading C) sentence
questions.a: A) dictation

questions.q: Bismillah. How is فِي البَيْتِ read? A) fi l-bayt B) fi al-bayt
questions.a: A) fi l-bayt

questions.q: What is الخَامِس? A) fifth B) five C) fifteen
questions.a: A) fifth

questions.q: Bismillah. 'I am in Year 8' is: A) أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الثَّامِنِ B) أَنَا ثَمَانِيَة
questions.a: A) أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الثَّامِنِ

questions.q: What does أَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ؟ ask? A) where you live B) your age C) your name
questions.a: A) where you live

questions.q: Bismillah. 'Where do you live?' to a boy: A) أَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ؟ B) مَا اسْمُكَ؟
questions.a: A) أَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ؟

questions.q: What is جِنْسِيَّة? A) nationality B) country C) language
questions.a: A) nationality

questions.q: Bismillah. 'She is Egyptian': A) هِيَ مِصْرِيَّةٌ B) هِيَ مِصْرِيٌّ
questions.a: A) هِيَ مِصْرِيَّةٌ

questions.q: What does أُسْرَة mean? A) family B) brother C) house
questions.a: A) family

arabic.text: أُسْرَتِي صَغِيرَةٌ. عِنْدِي أُخْتٌ وَاحِدَةٌ، اِسْمُهَا سَارَةُ، وَهِيَ أَكْبَرُ مِنِّي. أَبِي بِرِيطَانِيٌّ، لٰكِنَّ أُمِّي مِصْرِيَّةٌ. جَدَّتِي تَسْكُنُ مَعَنَا أَيْضًا، وَغُرْفَتُهَا بِجَانِبِ غُرْفَتِي.
